title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) officially limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Lamar Jackson (ankle) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jackson was able to make his return to practice on Wednesday and participated in a limited fashion. That's a big step in the right direction for his Week 7 availability, but the team isn't likely to make an official decision about his status until he has a couple more practices under his belt. Tyler Huntley will remain the starter for another week if Jackson still has to miss more time.

items.desc: Travis Kelce was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kelce is being managed in practice to start the week. He should be good to go in his usual role for Sunday.

items.desc: Chamarri Conner was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.

items.title: Cyrus Allen (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Cyrus Allen was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Allen is likely to be good to go on Sunday. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Calvin Ridley (hip) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Calvin Ridley (hip) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Ridley is managing a hip issue and was relegated to a limited role at practice on Wednesday as a result. It remains to be seen if he will have an injury designation going into Week 7, but either way he remains off of the fantasy radar at this point.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: KC Concepcion Jr. (calf/quad) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: KC Concepcion Jr. (calf/quad) was limited at Cleveland's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie is currently dealing with a pair of injuries and was limited at Wednesday's practice as a result. They could affect his availability or workload for Week 7, but we won't know more until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Elgton Jenkins (knee) a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Elgton Jenkins (knee) was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was a non-participant on Wednesday as he continues to manage a nagging knee issue. He should play in Week 7, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tytus Howard (knee) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Tytus Howard (knee) was limited at Cleveland's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was a limited participant to start the week on Wednesday. He has been playing through his knee issue recently, however, so he's likely to do so again in Week 7.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Teven Jenkins (back) remains out Wednesday
items.desc: Teven Jenkins (back) remained sidelined for Cleveland's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jenkins has been sidelined for an extended period of time due to this back issue, and to no surprise, he was again a non-participant at practice on Wednesday. We haven't seen any indication that he will be back anytime in the near future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dylan Sampson (knee) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Dylan Sampson (knee) was officially limited at Cleveland's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Sampson has been on injured reserve since the start of the season due to a persistent knee issue of some kind, but he seems to be nearly over it and was able to participate in Wednesday's practice in a limited fashion. He seems likely to play in Week 7, which would be bad news for the workload of Audric Estime and Jaleel McLaughlin moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The young running back missed last week's game due to an ankle issue, but he is limited to start practice this week and seems to have a real chance to play in Week 7. Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime will both see less work if that's the case.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mike Hall Jr. (ankle) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Mike Hall Jr. (ankle) was absent from Cleveland's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The young defensive tackle wasn't able to practice on Wednesday, which is no surprise given that he missed last week's game due to his ankle injury. It remains to be seen when he will be back in the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mason Graham (knee/ankle) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Mason Graham (knee/ankle) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Graham has been out for the last two games due to injuries, but he was able to practice on Wednesday and seems to be on track to play in Week 7. Cleveland's defensive front would see a nice boost this week if that's the case.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Denzel Boston (foot) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Denzel Boston (foot) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie is still dealing with a nagging foot issue and was limited for another practice on Wednesday as a result. He was able to play through it last week, however, so he is expected to do the same again in Week 7 unless he suffers a setback at practice this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Anthony Gould (concussion) a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Anthony Gould (concussion) was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Gould wasn't able to practice on Wednesday, as he is currently going through the NFL's concussion protocols. Fantasy managers shouldn't put much weight into his health one way or the other, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Ashton Dulin (hamstring) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Dulin has been out for a little while due to a hamstring issue that he's dealing with, but he was able to return to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday. He won't be fantasy relevant even if he's back in the lineup in Week 7, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keenan Allen (rest) sidelined at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Keenan Allen (rest) was sidelined at Indianapolis' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was held out of Wednesday's practice, which was to be expected, since the Colts have made a habit out of giving him at least one day off per week. He should be good to go for Week 7.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyler Warren (groin) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Tyler Warren (groin) did not take part in Indianapolis' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Warren was sidelined in Week 6 due to a groin issue, and he wasn't able to practice on Wednesday for the same reason. He's at risk of being sidelined again this week, but we won't know his official status until sometime later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Alijah Vera-Tucker (hamstring) ruled out for Thursday
items.desc: Alijah Vera-Tucker (hamstring) has been ruled out for Thursday night's game against the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: As expected, the veteran will be sidelined on Thursday night as he nurses a hamstring issue of some kind. New England's offensive line is dealing with several key players being injured right now, so their unit may be weaker than usual in Week 7.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Carlton Davis III (neck) won't play Thursday
items.desc: Carlton Davis III (neck) won't play in Thursday night's game against the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Davis is going to miss another game on Thursday night. He's still dealing with a neck injury, and it could leave him out beyond this game as well. New England's secondary will continue to be weaker than usual for however long he remains out of the lineup moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ben Brown (knee) sidelined for Thursday
items.desc: Ben Brown (knee) will be sidelined for Thursday's game against the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Brown is going to be sidelined on Thursday as he continues to recover from a knee issue. New England is expected to be short-handed on the offensive line with multiple starters set to be sidelined against the Bears.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Morgan Moses (foot) questionable for Thursday
items.desc: Morgan Moses (foot) is questionable for Thursday night's game against the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: The veteran is uncertain to play on Thursday night and is officially questionable with a foot issue. New England's offensive line will be much weaker than usual if he's ruled out ahead of game time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Craig Woodson (shoulder) listed questionable for Thursday
items.desc: Craig Woodson (shoulder) is listed questionable for Thursday's game against the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Woodson was able to practice in full all week, but he is still considered questionable to play ahead of Thursday night's game. New England's defense will be short handed if they are without their young defensive back in this matchup against the Bears.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: A.J. Brown (ankle) good to go for Thursday
items.desc: A.J. Brown (ankle) is good to go for Thursday night's game against the Chicago Bears.
items.impact: Brown was limited for New England's first two practices this week, but he returned to being a full participant on Wednesday and carries no injury designation ahead of Thursday night's game. Fantasy managers shouldn't hesitate to start him in this primetime matchup, even though he had a rough showing in his first game back last week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trevor Etienne (ankle) off injury report for Week 7
items.desc: Trevor Etienne (ankle) is off of the injury report for Week 7's game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
items.impact: Etienne was able to play last week and is no longer listed on the team's injury report heading into Week 7. He only saw one carry in Week 6, however, so fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to see much involvement for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: AJ Dillon (ankle) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: AJ Dillon (ankle) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: Dillon was sidelined last week due to the ankle injury that he's managing. He seems to be nearly over it at this point, however, as he was able to log a full practice to start the week on Wednesday. He will play a depth role on this offense if active moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chuba Hubbard (rest) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Chuba Hubbard (rest) was absent from Carolina's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Hubbard was given the day off on Wednesday as a typical veteran rest day. He should be back on Thursday and should be good to go for Week 7, assuming nothing happens at practice this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Sills V (hamstring) listed as full participant Wednesday
items.desc: David Sills V (hamstring) was listed as a full participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Sills has yet to be fully activated from injured reserve, but he seems to be close to full health at this point and was able to practice in full on Wednesday. His official status will be determined later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Sean Tucker (quad) full participant Wednesday
items.desc: Sean Tucker (quad) was a full participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Tucker was a full participant on Wednesday after missing last week's game due to a quad issue. He should be available to play in Week 7 but will only have fantasy relevance in the off-chance that Bucky Irving (illness) is unable to suit up on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Winfield was sidelined last week due to his rib injury, but he was able to take part in Wednesday's practice in a limited fashion, which indicates that he may be back in the lineup this week. Tampa Bay's defense will be improved if that's the case.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Benjamin Morrison (quad) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Benjamin Morrison (quad) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: The young cornerback was able to practice in full on Wednesday after missing some time with a quad injury. It looks like he will be back in Week 6, which is good news for Tampa Bay's secondary.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Baker Mayfield (thumb) officially logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Baker Mayfield (thumb) officially logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: Mayfield was able to return to practice for the Buccaneers on Wednesday and participated in a full capacity, which is a strong indication that he will be cleared to return to the lineup in Week 7. His probable return would be great news for the fantasy value of Bucky Irving (illness) and Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bucky Irving (illness) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Bucky Irving (illness) missed Tampa Bay's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Irving was absent from the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday, as he is currently recovering from an illness of some kind. It doesn't look like it will pose much of a threat for his availability for Week 7, so for now, fantasy managers should plan on him playing in a full capacity on Sunday.
